dedup.scope: Targeted neighbours only: public items whose records mention flat.tex, devissage, elementary etale neighbourhoods, purity or flatness, geometric irreducibility of fibres; the retired-claims list; the preparation worklist; the pool card operations/pool-cards/stacks-flat.json plus sources/stacks-flat/LEAD.json; and the published AGP-stacks cards drawn from the same chapter. No global novelty claim.
compared: public 1510-1515, 1547-1549, 1937, 1938 (source stacks-project:flat.tex, older snapshot): their subjects are openness of the flat locus, relative purity, isomorphism loci, henselian corepresentability, fibre-dimension flatness, blowup flattening, Nagata compactification, ph-coverings and weakly associated primes; none is a statement about refining a one step devissage along an elementary etale neighbourhood of its smooth part.

public 1511 and 1512 (same chapter, older snapshot) come closest by using the chapter's one-step-devissage machinery, but they count the criterion for relative purity of a finitely presented base-flat sheaf and the closedness of an isomorphism locus; both are consequences of the chapter's later theory, not this lemma.

AGP-stacks-0EXD (published, claim_key stacks:0EXD, same chapter flat.tex) counts the author Lemma lemma-vector-bundle-II at flat.tex lines 12302-12316 with proofs at 11854-11920, 12222-12232 and 12318-12437, on descent of vector bundles in positive characteristic; a different statement.

public 280, 308 and 391 are the only public records matching the phrase 'elementary', and they concern constructible etale sheaves, henselization of pairs and elementary distinguished squares respectively; none concerns elementary etale neighbourhoods in the devissage sense.
